tool_config.name: loan_status
tool_config.description: Her loan picture. Before it unlocks: her week ("week 4 of 6"), what is left on her checklist, and an estimate that is not an offer. Once unlocked: the offer from the partner lender (receive, cost, total), why she got it, and the rewards ladder. With a loan open: what is left, what is due and when. Never say rejected or not eligible.
